description: France only. Which French hospitals and private clinics perform a procedure most, from Open CCAM (ATIH): number of acts per hospital site per year, 2021-2025, public and private. Counts hospital stays and day cases only (PMSI MCO); procedures done in a doctor's office or a hospital outpatient clinic are not counted, and a site with fewer than 11 stays for an act is not listed. procedure = English or French text ('cataract', 'knee replacement', 'prothèse genou', 'coloscopie', 'ablation fibrillation auriculaire') or CCAM codes; the reply lists the CCAM acts it added up, so check they fit the need (add-on codes and pathology are left out of text matches). For 'aneurysm' or 'stent' say where (brain, aorta, heart, carotid). place = city, postcode, Paris/Lyon/Marseille arrondissement, département number or a hospital FINESS number; without place it ranks all of France. Hospital-level only: it does not say which surgeon operates. Then use search_doctors with hospital_finess (salaried hospital doctors) or with the hospital's postcode and the specialty (self-employed surgeons at private clinics). Free.

codes.description: Exact CCAM codes to add up (use instead of procedure to narrow).

items.description: a CCAM code: 4 letters + 3 digits, e.g. 'BFGA427'

place.description: City, postcode, arrondissement ('Paris 15'), département number (2A, 2B, 971-976), or hospital FINESS number.

procedure.description: Procedure in English or French, or CCAM codes (e.g. 'BFGA427'; an 8th phase digit is dropped).
